method.neighbourhood: Cells whose centres lie within 15 km of the CDFW port point.
method.charm_leads: Statistics from the published C-HARM value grids of the current run (same values as the map).
method.charm_history: Median over the same neighbourhood for each C-HARM nowcast in the last 30 days available on ERDDAP; days without a run are absent.
method.chlorophyll: Median of valid NOAA VIIRS S-NPP 750 m pixels (8-day composites, time = centre of the 8-day window, successive values overlap). Cloud and land pixels are excluded; a missing value means no clear observation.
method.official: A record is related to a port if it is statewide, names the port's county, has official latitudes that include the port, or its official polygon lies within 60 km.
